I answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The depot was **Southgate**.

I only used that incident channel, which he's a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4 while label printing was stalled. She posted again at 18:43 that day to say the outage was resolved and Southgate had cleared the backlog.
